name: overload-key-ps-suffix
body: Limit: overload_key splits a function FQN on its last '(' and then its last '.', unaware of PowerShell's //<repo-relative path>:<ordinal> suffix or dotted function names, so a ps FQN can be given a wrong parent scope or miss overload grouping. It is sound because every ps-derived scope is 'ps' or starts with 'ps.' and never equals another language's scope, and rust.apg.ps.widen_targets re-emits every ps file whenever any ps file is targeted, so ps overload peers are never needed. Upgrade if ps incremental impact ever relies on overload grouping alone.
